title: Go + TypeScript/JavaScript + services slice: gate for the first scored agent A/B

measured_at.note: Values under 'current' were read from evals/ground_truth/baseline.json at this commit; tools/milestone_status.py reads the live baseline.

contracts.rule: Service pairs summed over all gated kinds. Recall at least min_pair_recall and no predicted pair outside the labels. Every other contract corpus in the manifest keeps recall 1.0 and precision 1.0 on service pairs.

held_out.rule: One Go and one TypeScript repository, chosen and sealed on 2026-11-24, never used for tuning. The verification thread unseals, pins and labels impact truth (tools/impact_truth.py) only after every other criterion is green. Thresholds: impact recall at least 0.90, precision at least 0.99. If a repo cannot be labelled (oracle failure), its sealed reserve is used instead; the reason is recorded.
held_out.sealed_format: sha256 of the UTF-8 JSON object {go, typescript, reserves, salt} serialised with sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':')

capabilities: getImpact, getFunctionCallers, getComponentImpact and diffSnapshots answer against a freshly indexed task repository through the MCP server used by the runner
every edge those tools return carries its rule ID (explainEdge resolves it)
graders affected-set-v1, change-plan-v1, change-check-v1 and exact-fact-v1 exist, with positive and negative controls in tests
a two-task dry run (one Go, one services task) on myarch shows graph read receipts in the treatment arm

arms.baseline: Read-only checkout of the pinned corpus, shell search tools (rg, find, sed, cat), Python and Node; no DeepThought access
arms.treatment: The same plus the DeepThought MCP server over a read-only Neo4j snapshot of the same pinned corpus; no graph facts injected into the prompt

protocol.agent: Codex CLI on myarch under the operator's personal subscription; same CLI version, model and reasoning effort in both arms, recorded in every record; fresh ephemeral session per run; no paid API
protocol.order: Per task: baseline, treatment, treatment, baseline, baseline, treatment for odd-numbered tasks in the list above; the mirror image for even-numbered tasks
protocol.retries: None. Incomplete runs are kept and reported.
metrics: correctness: recall, precision and F1 of the answer against task truth; must-change recall for plan tasks; missed-site recall and false alarms for check tasks
wrong claims: answer items contradicted by truth
total native tokens (input plus output; cached and reasoning as reported subsets)
tool calls, graph reads (treatment), files read
preparation cost: index and Neo4j import seconds per corpus, reported separately

decision_rule.status: proposed; to be confirmed by Luke before the first scored run, then frozen
decision_rule.value: On the 9 scored tasks, treatment mean F1 at least 0.10 higher than baseline, wrong claims not higher, and median total tokens no more than 10% higher
decision_rule.overhead: On the 3 control tasks, report the token and time overhead of the treatment arm; above 25% is recorded as a finding to fix, not hidden
